recommendation_reason: Rewrite B (qwen2.5:14b) aligns better with the job listing’s practical focus, even if it lacks explicit technical repair details. While both rewrites fail to address core computer repair skills, Rewrite B’s competencies (customer service, inventory management) and mention of leadership/initiative-taking are marginally more relevant to the role’s customer-facing and organizational needs. Rewrite A’s buzzword-heavy language and dropped numerical achievements (e.g., 100% attendance) make it less credible and misaligned with the job’s emphasis on hands-on technical ability and reliability. The fact-check results further validate Rewrite B’s superior adherence to the original CV’s factual content.

career_roadmap.step: Apply for the role with Rewrite B
career_roadmap.action: Submit Rewrite B to Mick@brendaandmicksrepairs-example.co.uk, emphasizing the customer service and problem-solving competencies listed, even if technical repair experience is not explicitly stated.

Enroll in a short-term computer repair certification program (e.g., CompTIA A+ or local vocational courses) to gain hands-on experience with hardware diagnostics, OS troubleshooting, and basic repairs.
